svg.aria-label: Tape to board. Magnetic tape runs out of a slot in the walnut chassis, across, and threads into the back of a black station board, driving a row of flaps spelling EVIDENCE. Said straight: when a machine makes a decision that can't be undone, what evidence is left for a person to check it against? That's the work.
